Removed rather than left as a guard that cannot fail. ⚠ RETIRED 2026-08-14 (§83): '★ THE FREEZE: refresh must compare before writing the stage box'. api run 5 measured OnTextChanged as DEFERRED, COALESCED and CHANGE-ONLY, so the synchronous unbounded recursion it proved is one the client CANNOT PRODUCE - the guard it targeted was replaced by a userInput gate. Removed rather than left proving a fiction.
